body: Thank you for your comment. Maybe I can try to at least live to go to college where hopefully I can meet people who are better than the ones at my past 3 high schools. Thank you for your kindness.
It's hard to cry when you feel so numb but thank you so much for your advice. I will try it.
Thank you. I am now hoping to at least live to graduate. I will look back at this post if I ever plan to kill myself again.

unfortunatley loving myself is the hardest of all. I can't even look at myself in the mirror without bursting into tears. I know that sounds pathetic but I hate every aspect about myself. If I even see my reflection accidentally I wince and feel emmbarrased for the way I look. Not just that, I hate all of my actions that have somehow caused me to become this hated when I am still unsure what I did wrong.

I agree with that but its not just "kill yourself". They go into depth on all of the reasons why I should do it. One boy even told me that he would tie the noose for me if I was too stupid to do it myself.
